mike_sales: Hey product — FinWave (sales) asks to onboard Oryx-13B-Plus into catalog. Need EU data residency, pin to v1.2.0, fallback to oryx-13b-q4 when full precision isn't available. SLA target 99.95%, expected 120M tokens/month and bursts to 400qps.
ashley_pm: Can you confirm hosted vs private? Also what's required for pinning — model artifacts + checksums?
mike_sales: Hosted preferred (EU region). They want pin so their traffic always hits v1.2.0 until we approve upgrades. Will provide model tarball and OCI manifest.
rachel_cs: Are they doing sensitive PII processing? Any HIPAA/GDPR notes?
mike_sales: Mostly financial docs + KYC PII. GDPR applies; they want logs erased after 30 days.
jenna_privacy: For GDPR erasure we need retention config + audit events. Private would simplify but hosted is ok if we surface retention controls. Need SOC2 + DPA signed.
dmitri_eng: Runtime side: Oryx base model loads fine but we haven't benchmarked v1.2.0. We need a perf sweep for v1.2.0 and q4 quant variant. Can someone drop sample prompts and expected latency SLOs? Also need kv-cache size stats.
mike_sales: Sample prompt set attached in the ticket (link: https://redwood/reqs/FX-483). Latency SLO = p95 < 450ms for typical 512-token seq.
deploy-bot: CI: onboarding-checks started for oryx-13b-plus v1.2.0 (artifact checksum OK).
ashley_pm: Proposal: triage as P1 for EU pin (customer is enterprise with committed spend). Acceptance criteria: 1) artifact validation + checksum, 2) perf report (p50/p95), 3) privacy config for retention+erasure, 4) canary rollout plan (10% -> 50% -> 100% with rollback), 5) infra capacity estimate + cost delta. Timeline ask: target next sprint (2 weeks). Thoughts?
dmitri_eng: Agreed. I can run perf sweep but need access to the artifact — mike, share S3 creds or upload to internal model registry. If quant perf is within 1.5x token cost savings, we can recommend auto-fallback.
mike_sales: Uploading to model-reg now. FYI they also want APAC read-only availability later — not blocking EU launch.
ashley_pm: Ok moving to product backlog intake. I'll create a spec PR with acceptance criteria and link to ticket. Assigning eng to do perf sweep. If privacy signoffs look good, schedule canary next Wednesday.
rachel_cs: Noted — I'll initiate DPA flow and privacy checklist with the customer.
jenna_privacy: I'll review retention configs once artifact + usage patterns are in.
mike_sales: Thanks team. Will update ticket when upload complete. :thumbsup:
